name: M10-1A-21, 2P
headline: Tropical 2BDR W/Rooftop @ Mangroovy | Pool & Beach Access
summary: Your elevated stay at Mangroovy, El Gouna’s only beachfront residence — where laid-back luxury meets the Red Sea breeze.

description.Space:
This trendy 2-bedroom apartment offers direct access to both the pool and beach, combining comfort and convenience in one of Gouna’s most sought-after locations.

Inside, you’ll find:
✔️ Two thoughtfully designed bedrooms with cozy beds and calming, stylish decor
✔️ Two full bathrooms, including one ensuite — with fresh towels provided
✔️ A welcoming living room with comfortable seating and natural light
✔️ An open-plan, fully equipped kitchen with a microwave, kettle, Nespresso machine, utensils, and washing machine
✔️ A private balcony — plus a spacious furnished rooftop
✔️ A 55” Smart TV with AirPlay and cable channels
✔️ Complimentary bottled water and Nespresso coffee capsules
✔️ Access to Mangroovy’s exclusive beachfront and free swimming pools
description.Access:
✔️ Guests will have full private access to the apartment and all of its amenities during their stay
✔️ Guests will also enjoy access to compound facilities (pools, beaches, communal areas — subject to compound rules)
✔️ For larger groups or multiple bookings, feel free to contact us — we may have additional units available in the same compound or nearby.
description.Interaction:
✔️We’re available to assist you between 9:00 AM and 4:00 AM Cairo time.
✔️Whether you have questions before arrival or need help during your stay, our team is happy to support you on via Airbnb messages throughout your experience.
description.Neighborhood:
Mangroovy is El Gouna’s only beachfront residence, uniquely located just 800 meters from Abu Tig Marina — about a 10-minute walk. Guests enjoy both convenience and exclusivity, with direct access to sandy beaches and some of Gouna’s best dining and lifestyle spots.

✔️ Wonderful location with direct access to El Gouna’s beaches
✔️ Abu Tig Marina – famous for yachts, fine dining, nightlife, and seaside strolls (10 min walk)
✔️ Bright Star supermarket – directly in front of the residence toward the Marina
✔️ ZOUNi Beach Lounge – located at Mangroovy’s beach
✔️ The Smokery – a local favorite, just 450 meters away
✔️ Downtown El Gouna – lively hub with restaurants, cafés, shops, bars, and supermarkets
✔️ Popular beach clubs and lounges nearby (charges may apply)
✔️ Wide range of water sports – kitesurfing, diving, and boat trips
✔️ Family-friendly facilities – shared pools, landscaped gardens, and outdoor spaces
✔️ Safe, gated community with 24/7 security
✔️ Everyday convenience – supermarkets, pharmacies, and essential services close by
✔️ Cultural and lifestyle events – film festivals, concerts, and exhibitions often hosted in El Gouna
description.Transit:
✔️ Tuk-tuks are the most popular and convenient way to get around Gouna
✔️ Walking distance to beaches, restaurants, and supermarkets 
✔️ Downtown El Gouna: 5–10 mins (cafes, supermarkets, pharmacies)
✔️ Abu Tig Marina: About a 10-minute walk (restaurants, shops, nightlife, yachts)
✔️ Gouna Conference Center & Golf Courses: 10–15 mins
✔️ El Gouna Hospital: 10–15 mins
✔️ Hurghada International Airport: 30–40 mins
✔️ Free Parking on premises
description.Notes:
⚠️ Entry Requirements for El Gouna
✔️Egyptian nationals: National ID (front & back) + authentic proof of marriage (for couples)
✔️Arab nationals: Passport copy + authentic proof of marriage (for couples)
✔️Other nationalities: Passport copy only (no marriage proof required)

⚠️ If one partner is Egyptian/Arab and the other is not, proof of marriage is required
✔️ QR Codes for entry are issued by El Gouna Community Care. Please submit all required IDs 48 hours before check-in so we can arrange your entry QR.
Late submissions may cause delays or denial of entry. Approvals are fully at the discretion of El Gouna Community Care.
✔️ Smoking is only allowed outdoors (fine of $100 applies indoors)
✔️ Visitors are not permitted — only registered guests may enter
✔️ Please switch off AC and lights when leaving the apartment
✔️ Kindly leave the unit tidy upon checkout.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. 
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

reviews.review: Great place, Very clean and cozy, host was always active and helpful. highly recommended!

It was really nice place 
I had a great in it, thank you so much 🙏🏻
Everything was great, however, there was a leaking problem in the bathroom and they had to shut it down for 2 days. That was the negative part.

I am writing to express my profound disappointment and frustration regarding my recent experience with your property. The discrepancies between the advertised features and the actual conditions of the apartment I rented are simply unacceptable and amount to false advertising.
Firstly, the advertisement clearly stated that the apartment includes two bathrooms. Upon arrival, I was shocked to discover that only one bathroom was functional, while the other was under construction. This was not only inconvenient but also misleading. Additionally, the listing claimed that the rooms were located on the "second floor" of the apartment. Imagine my surprise when I found out that there is no second floor at all—just a roof. This blatant misrepresentation of the apartment's layout is inexcusable.
Furthermore, the description mentioned that the apartment offers scenic views. Instead, what greeted us were obstructed vistas of ongoing construction work

The place was simply amazing, the unit was very well furnished, clean and equipped with all appliances,  clean bathrooms. Spacious rooms with additional extended sofa bed, would definitely recommend it for Families who want to spend some relaxing and chilling vacation. 

this is my third year to go to mangroovy, the place is very family friendly with lots of amenities, this year the commercial area is operative with a pharmacy, supermarket, coffee shop and local traditional Egyptian food , Al Gouna is a true heaven for relaxation and enjoyment of the Red Sea vibes
We had a great stay, it was an amazing and very clean unit I highly recommend it for sure 🫰🏽
